businessHours.title: Business hours
businessHours.description: Working days and hours used to count deadlines (approval SLAs and later due dates). One record is the default; units can use their own.
businessHours.timeZoneHint: IANA name, e.g. Asia/Dubai. Empty: the installation's time zone.
businessHours.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate “{{name}}”? Units using it fall back to their parent unit's business hours or the default.

units.title: Units with their own business hours
units.description: A unit uses its own record; otherwise it follows its parent unit, then the default.
units.empty: Every unit follows the default business hours.

calculator.title: Try a deadline
calculator.description: Add working hours to a moment with one record (holidays included).

holidays.title: Holidays
holidays.description: Days or hours when no work counts. Hijri-based holidays are entered each year as one-time dates.
holidays.name: Name
holidays.confirmRemove: Remove “{{name}}”? Deadlines calculated from now on will count it as a working day.
holidays.recurringSwitch: Repeats every year on the same date
holidays.recurringHint: Fixed-date holidays only. For Hijri-based ones, add each year's dates as one-time holidays.

import.title: Import holidays
import.description: Fill in the template (one row per holiday) for the chosen year. Nothing is saved unless every row is valid.

errors.unknownTimeZone: Unknown time zone. Use an IANA name such as Asia/Dubai.
errors.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
errors.noWorkingDay: At least one day must have working hours.
errors.defaultCannotBeDeactivated: The default business hours cannot be deactivated. Make another record the default first.
errors.inactiveCannotBeDefault: Activate the record before making it the default.
errors.holidayTooLong: A holiday lasts at most {{max}} days.
errors.recurringAcrossYear: A holiday that repeats every year must stay within one calendar year.
errors.holidayRecords: Choose at least one active business-hours record, or apply the holiday to all.
errors.holidayOverlap: Overlaps “{{nameEn}}” on {{date}} for the same business hours.
